description: Seed scenario compiler contract — idempotent, deterministic, safe fixtures

rules.title: Upsert only
rules.description: Seed files must use upsert (createOrUpdate, ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) — no bare inserts that fail on re-run

rules.title: No random data
rules.description: Seed data must be deterministic — no Math.random(), faker.*, uuid(), nanoid() unless spec.allowRandom: true

rules.title: Cleanup declared
rules.description: Every seed module must export a teardown/cleanup/reset function for test isolation

rules.title: No production data
rules.description: Seed files must not contain real PII — no real SSNs, credit cards, production email domains, or real phone numbers

rules.title: No TODOs
rules.description: No TODO, FIXME, or HACK comments in any source file

rules.title: Tests pass
rules.description: All test files in the module pass (vitest or jest)
